FInterviews

Interview FAQs — Grokking System Design

Current-era interviews me system design se poochhe jaane wale sabse kaam ke 36 sawaal — har jawab wahi hai jo is SPA ke sections me detail me samjhaya gaya hai. Kisi bhi sawaal par click karke jawab kholo.

Q01 System design interview me sabse pehle kya karna chahiye?
Sabse pehle problem ko scope karo — clarifying questions poochho. Requirements kya hain, kitne users hain, read-heavy hai ya write-heavy, kya features chahiye aur kya nahi chahiye. Bina scope kiye design karna sabse badi galti hai — interviewer dekhna chahta hai ki tum assume nahi karte, poochhte ho.
Q02 Back-of-the-envelope estimation kyun zaroori hai?
Ye batata hai ki system kitna bada hoga — QPS, storage aur bandwidth ke rough numbers se pata chalta hai ki cache chahiye ya nahi, sharding kab chahiye, aur kaun sa database sahi rahega. Exact number nahi chahiye, order-of-magnitude sahi hona chahiye. Lab 6 me practice karo.
Q03 Horizontal scaling aur vertical scaling me kya farq hai?
Horizontal scaling me pool me aur servers jodte hain (load balancer ke peeche N servers); vertical scaling me existing server me CPU/RAM/storage badhate hain. Vertical me downtime aata hai aur ek upper limit hoti hai. Aaj ke systems zyada tar horizontal scaling use karte hain.
Q04 99.9% availability ka matlab kya hai?
99.9% availability (three nines) ka matlab hai saal me lagbhag 8.76 ghante ka downtime acceptable hai. 99% par ~3.65 din, 99.99% par ~52.6 minute aur 99.999% par sirf ~5.26 minute downtime hota hai. Interview me availability ka number maangna aur uska downtime nikalna ek achha move hai.
Q05 Reliability aur availability me kya farq hai?
Reliability matlab ek period me system fail hone ki probability kitni kam hai; availability matlab system kitne time operational raha. Reliable system available hota hai, lekin available system zaroori nahi ki reliable ho — jaise security hole wala system attack na hone tak available hai, lekin reliable nahi hai.
Q06 Cache kahan lagana chahiye?
Cache har level par lag sakta hai — client side, CDN, load balancer, application server, aur database ke saamne. Sabse zyada fayda us jagah hota hai jahan hot data baar-baar manga jata hai. 80-20 rule yaad rakho: 20% data 80% traffic generate karta hai, use hi cache karo.
Q07 Write-through, write-around aur write-back cache me kya farq hai?
Write-through me data cache aur permanent storage me ek saath likha jata hai (consistent, lekin write slow). Write-around me data sirf permanent storage me likha jata hai (cache bharna kam, lekin abhi likha data maangne par miss). Write-back me data sirf cache me likha jata hai aur baad me storage me (tez, lekin disruption par data loss ka risk).
Q08 LRU aur LFU eviction me kaun sa behtar hai?
LRU (least recently used) us data ko nikalta hai jo sabse purana use hua; LFU (least frequently used) use jo sabse kam baar use hua. LRU zyada tar cases me kaafi hai aur implement karna aasan hai. LFU tab behtar hai jab kuch keys baar-baar aati hain aur kuch ek baar aakar kabhi nahi aati — LFU un ek-baar-wali keys ko jaldi nikal deta hai.
Q09 CDN kab use karna chahiye?
Jab static media (images, videos, files) serve karni ho aur users alag-alag jagah se aate hon. CDN content ko user ke kareeb wale edge server par cache karke latency kam karta hai. Chhote system me CDN ke bina shuru kar sakte ho — static media alag subdomain se Nginx se serve karo, baad me DNS CDN par cutover kar do.
Q10 Sharding kab karni chahiye?
Jab ek database machine par data ya load nahi samaata — storage full ho, ya read/write load ek machine se handle na ho. Sharding se pehle socho: kya read replicas, caching ya vertical scaling kaafi hai? Sharding complexity bahut badhati hai — joins mushkil, referential integrity mushkil, rebalancing mushkil.
Q11 Range, hash aur directory-based partitioning me kaun sa chunoon?
Range-based simple hai lekin hot shard ka risk hai; hash-based load evenly baantta hai lekin range queries mushkil; directory-based flexible hai (scheme badlo bina app badle) lekin lookup service single point of failure ban sakti hai. Data aur query pattern dekh kar chuno — Lab 7 me practice karo.
Q12 Consistent hashing kyun use hoti hai?
Simple hashing (key % n) me server jodne/hatane par lagbhag saari keys remap hoti hain. Consistent hashing me sirf k/n keys move hoti hain (k = total keys, n = servers). Isse distributed cache aur sharded databases me server add/remove karna safe ho jata hai. Virtual replicas se hot spots bhi handle hote hain.
Q13 SQL vs NoSQL — kaun sa kab chunoon?
SQL chuno jab ACID compliance chahiye, data structured hai aur relations hain. NoSQL chuno jab data unstructured hai, rapid development hai, ya horizontal scaling sasti chahiye. Real systems dono use karte hain — jaise Postgres + Redis + Elasticsearch ek hi system me. Data model aur query pattern se decide karo, fashion se nahi.
Q14 CAP theorem ka asli matlab kya hai?
CAP kehta hai network partition hone par consistency aur availability me se ek chunna padega. Galatfahmi ye hai ki hamesha ek chhodni padegi — asal me chunav sirf partition ke time hota hai; baaki time C aur A dono mil sakte hain. Banking me CP, shopping cart aur feed me AP chunna common hai.
Q15 Load balancer ke algorithms kaun se hain?
Round robin (baari-baari), weighted round robin (bade servers ko zyada), least connections (sabse kam busy server), least response time (sabse tez server), least bandwidth, aur IP hash (ek hi user hamesha ek hi server par). Long-lived connections ke liye least connections, session stickiness ke liye IP hash best hai.
Q16 Forward proxy aur reverse proxy me kya farq hai?
Forward proxy client ki taraf hota hai — client ki identity chhupata hai aur content filter karta hai. Reverse proxy server ki taraf hota hai — load balancing, SSL termination, caching aur rate limiting karta hai. System design me zyada tar reverse proxy (Nginx, API gateway) ki baat hoti hai.
Q17 Message queue kab use karni chahiye?
Jab kaam slow hai lekin user ko turant jawab chahiye (email, notification, video processing), jab producer aur consumer ko decouple karna hai, ya jab traffic spikes ko absorb karna hai. Queue outage se bhi bachati hai — backend down ho to messages queue me safe rehti hain.
Q18 Polling, long-polling, WebSockets aur SSE me kya farq hai?
Polling me client baar-baar poochhta hai (overhead zyada). Long-polling me server update aane tak wait karta hai. WebSockets me dono taraf se kabhi bhi data ja sakta hai (chat, gaming). SSE me sirf server se client ki taraf data aata hai (live feed, notifications). Real-time aur bidirectional chahiye to WebSockets; sirf server updates chahiye to SSE.
Q19 Short URL service me 6 characters kyun kaafi hain?
Base64 ke 64 characters se 6 letters = 64^6 = ~68.7 billion unique keys. Repo ke hisaab se 30 billion URLs (5 saal) store karne hain, to 68.7 billion kaafi hai. 8 letters par ~281 trillion keys milti hain — zaroorat nahi, aur URL lambi ho jati hai.
Q20 KGS (Key Generation Service) kyun chahiye?
Agar har app server khud key banaye to do servers ek hi key bana sakte hain (collision). KGS pehle se random keys generate karke database me rakhta hai aur har server ko alag key deta hai — keys ko used/unused tables me mark karta hai. Isse concurrency issue khatam ho jata hai.
Q21 Pastebin aur Short URL design me kya similar hai?
Dono me short unique key generation, metadata + content ka alag storage, read-heavy traffic aur expiry/cleanup chahiye hoti hai. Farq: Pastebin me content bada hota hai (text/code) aur object storage me jata hai; Short URL me sirf mapping hoti hai. Dono me cache aur KGS jaisi key service kaam aati hai.
Q22 Instagram/Twitter feed fanout on write vs fanout on read kya hai?
Fanout on write (push) me post bante hi followers ke feeds me daal do — read tez, write mehenga. Fanout on read (pull) me feed read karte time banao — write sasta, read mehenga. Celebrity ke millions of followers hain to push bahut mehenga hai — isliye hybrid use hota hai: normal users ke liye push, celebrities ke liye pull.
Q23 YouTube video playback smooth kaise hoti hai?
Adaptive streaming (DASH/HLS) se — video chhote segments me tooti hoti hai aur multiple resolutions me transcode hoti hai. Player network speed ke hisaab se resolution badalta rehta hai. Videos CDN se serve hoti hain, isliye user ke kareeb se aati hain.
Q24 Twitter Search real-time kaise kaam karta hai?
Inverted index se — har word se us word wale tweet IDs ki list. Naya tweet aate hi use turant in-memory index me daalo, phir disk par flush karo. Query aate hi saare shards se parallel me poochho (scatter-gather) aur results merge karke rank karo.
Q25 Web crawler me politeness kyun zaroori hai?
Agar crawler ek site ko bahut tez crawl kare to site overload ho jayegi ya crawler ko block kar degi. Isliye robots.txt maano, per-host rate limit rakho aur DNS cache karo. Politeness aur speed ka trade-off hai — interview me iska naam lena achha impression deta hai.
Q26 Dropbox me file change par poori file dobara kyun nahi upload hoti?
Chunking se — file ko chhote blocks (jaise 4MB) me todo; sirf badla hua block dobara upload hota hai. Har block ka content hash rakho — same block dobara store mat karo (deduplication). Isse bandwidth aur storage dono bachte hain.
Q27 Uber me rider ko driver seconds me kaise milta hai?
Drivers ki live location geo-index (geohash) me rakhi hoti hai — rider ke aas-paas ke available drivers milliseconds me mil jate hain. Dispatch kareeb ke drivers ko offer karta hai; pehle accept karne wale ko trip milti hai. Location updates in-memory index me hoti hain, database me har update nahi likha jata.
Q28 Ticketmaster me ek seat do baar kaise nahi bikti?
Seat select karte hi use temporarily hold kar do (jaise 10 minute) — tab tak koi aur use nahi le sakta. Har event ki seat inventory ka single source of truth rakho (event par shard). Payment hone par hi ticket confirm karo; payment fail ho to hold chhodo. Flash sale me virtual queue se users ko baari-baari andar aane do.
Q29 Yelp me 'mere aas-paas ke restaurants' itni tez kaise milte hain?
Geospatial index se — latitude/longitude ko geohash string me convert karo; paas wali jagahon ke geohash prefix same hote hain. Search karte time user ke geohash ke aas-paas wale cells ke businesses lao, phir distance + rating + reviews se rank karo.
Q30 Facebook Messenger me message kabhi kho ta kyun nahi hai?
Message pehle queue aur message store me likha jata hai, phir receiver ko deliver hota hai. Receiver offline ho to message queue me rehta hai — online aate hi deliver ho jata hai. Har conversation me sequence number se order bana rehta hai.
Q31 System design interview me diagram kaisa banana chahiye?
Boxes aur arrows saaf hone chahiye: client, load balancer, app servers, cache, database, queue — har component ka naam aur uska kaam likho. Pehle high-level diagram banao, phir ek-do components me deep dive karo. Diagram banate time bolte raho — chup chaap mat banao.
Q32 Interview me trade-offs kaise discuss karoon?
Har decision ke saath 'kyun' aur 'kya khoya' batao — jaise cache lagaya to consistency ka risk, sharding ki to joins mushkil, AP chuna to stale data. Interviewer perfect design nahi, sochne ka tareeka dekh raha hai. Agar tum khud trade-off point out karte ho to bahut achha impression padta hai.
Q33 Design questions ki practice kaise karoon?
Har question par 45 minute ka timer lagao: 5 min scope, 5 min requirements/API, 5 min estimation, 10 min high-level design, 5 min data model, 10 min deep dive, 5 min bottlenecks. Phir apne design ko reference solution se compare karo. Lab 8 ka 45-minute plan use karo.
Q34 Grokking repo ki sabse badi kami kya hai?
Repo ki 11 design files me sirf diagrams hain — likha hua design sirf Short URL ka hai. Is SPA me un diagrams ko samjhaya gaya hai aur har design ka poora walkthrough diya gaya hai, lekin ye walkthrough diagram ki explanation hai, repo ka original text nahi — Trust Check me ye imaandari se likha hai.
Q35 Company engineering blogs interview me kyun useful hain?
Questions aam taur par usi domain ke honge jis company me interview de rahe ho. Agar tumne us company ka blog padha hai to tumhe pata hoga wo kaun si problems solve karte hain aur kaun si technologies use karte hain — aur tumhare answers me wahi vocabulary aur context dikhega.
Q36 System design seekhne me kitna time lagta hai?
Repo khud kehta hai — ek mahine me seekhne ka impression mat lo. Pehle basics (2-3 hafte), phir 10-12 designs ki practice (4-6 hafte), phir mock interviews. Roz ek design karo aur uske trade-offs likho — 2 mahine me solid grip ban jati hai.
